summary: **Keppi's Cosmic Coffee Break** follows a friendly space telescope named Keppi whose eyes grow dry and solar batteries run low after staring at the stars for too long. Spotting a cozy beacon in deep space, Keppi visits the Galactic Coffee Stop, where kind blue aliens serve up "Nebula Roast" coffee that recharges Keppi’s batteries to 100%. Energized and ready to explore, Keppi discovers a brand-new planet filled with glowing crystal craters and befriends its tiny local inhabitants, the Crystalians. After beaming the exciting news of the new world and friends back to Mission Control on Earth, Keppi drifts peacefully among the stars for a well-deserved goodnight rest.
details: After staring at the stars for too long, Keppi the space telescope grows weary with dry eyes and low solar batteries. Spotting a cozy beacon in deep space, Keppi stops at the Galactic Coffee Stop, where friendly blue aliens recharge Keppi's batteries to 100% with "Nebula Roast" coffee. Energized and ready to explore, Keppi discovers a colorful new planet filled with glowing crystal craters, befriends its tiny local inhabitants—the Crystalians—and beams the exciting news back to Mission Control on Earth before drifting off for a starry goodnight.
